From: elaine.zhu@velocorp.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: security@velocorp.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: KMS / HSM evidence request (SIG / CAIQ fields)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Velocorp's audit team is preparing for a SIG/CAIQ deep-dive focused on encryption and key management. To move the review forward they asked for a compact evidence package. Can you please provide the following by end of week?

1) KMS architecture diagram showing logical separation between tenant KEKs and service KEKs, plus network flow for envelope encryption.
2) HSM attestation summary (FIPS / vendor attestation PDF or statement).
3) Key rotation policy and a sample of rotation/log entries covering the last 90 days (redacted tenant IDs ok).
4) BYOK handshake example (request/response payloads, timestamps).
5) Mapping of CAIQ/SIG controls to Redwood artifacts (short table).

We attached our evidence template (Velocorp_Evidence_Request_v1.xlsx) to make it easy.

Also a couple of clarifying Qs from the audit team: do you retain operator shift logs tied to key events (evictions / emergency rewraps)? And can rotation timestamps be provided in UTC?

Appreciate the help — this will be used for our SOC 2 prep and an internal risk review.

Best,
Elaine Zhu
Senior Security Engineer
Velocorp
[Attachment: Velocorp_Evidence_Request_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: elaine.zhu@velocorp.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: KMS / HSM evidence request (SIG / CAIQ fields)

Hi Elaine,

Thanks — we can assemble that. Quick answers up front:
- Rotation timestamps will be UTC.
- We can provide redacted rotation/log samples (tenant IDs replaced with hashed tokens) and a sanitized BYOK handshake example.
- We host HSMs via our third-party provider; we can share the attestation summary and the certificate metadata (full vendor certs are available under NDA if you need them).

Owners and ETA: Marissa will own artifact collection; Aditya will produce the architecture diagram and CAIQ mapping. Proposed delivery: Friday 2027-06-25 EOD PT. If you need anything earlier, let us know which artifacts are highest priority.

Couple of clarifying asks from our side:
1) For rotation samples, do your auditors need raw operator usernames or is role-based labeling (e.g., operator_01) sufficient?
2) For BYOK traces, is a single tenant example sufficient or should we provide both tenant-initiated and platform-initiated examples?

I'll loop Marissa and Aditya below.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

- kms_architecture_v2.pdf (logical diagram, envelope flow, KEK separation)
- hsm_attestation_summary.pdf (vendor statement, FIPS level, attestation date)
- rotation_samples_90d_redacted.csv (90-day rotation events with tenant hashes, UTC timestamps, operator role labels)
- byok_handshake_example.txt (sanitized request/response with headers and timestamps)

- Rotation events include both automatic scheduled rotations and operator-initiated emergency rewraps; emergency rewraps are labeled in the CSV.

Attachments are listed below. Please confirm receipt and whether your auditors prefer CSV or a secure Share link for the rotation log export.

Thanks,
